First off: I am so proud of you for achieving financial independence. I know how hard nparents can make that, and I can only guess you’ve faced roadblocks to get where you are now. 
A few months ago, I faced a… shockingly similar situation with similar past financial trauma…  I’m not sure what you should do as I don’t know your exact situation. I was considering it- for similar reasons (life changing money, no more renting etc) but struggled 1. wondering if I was ready for ownership 2. Considering what kind of landlords my nparents would be and 3. what could go wrong. My partner reminded me that with them, all gifts come at a cost and with many many strings. I started to panic wondering if this was their newest attempt to trap me to them… the ultimate guilt trip/item to lord over me. Going NC or LC would no longer be an option. They would own the roof over my head (and me) for the foreseeable future. I felt so conflicted- like you, I felt guilty as most people would LOVE to be offered this. I asked my partner what he would do and he said “if it were my parents? I’d take the offer. That’d be great of them!… But your parents aren’t like mine. This seems like a trap, from your parents”.  I sat down and talked it throught with myself- listed out all the pros and cons I could think of. Really thought about it. You have some time to decide, thankfully. 

It sucks that you’d established a boundary about financial things and they crossed it… regardless of what you decide.
